edit.description: Use namespacedJoin for fs-call paths per platform-facts.md, at: ensureRuntimeIgnores (:93), jobNew's mkdir/cp (:187-190), liveLoopPid (:286-287), jobRm's existence check (:331-334), jobStatus's existence checks (:448-449,456,465,472). Mirror countFrictionFiles/readPendingLoose in the same file, which already do this.
Add a win32 long-path regression per the existing FRICTIONCOUNT-WIN32-PATH-TOTAL-LIMIT suite (:1308), for liveLoopPid/jobRm/jobStatus's existsSync-gated checks.

summary: job.ts builds fs-call paths with bare join() instead of namespacedJoin() at several existsSync-gated sites, silently misreading long-path state on win32

per.section: Windows MAX_PATH (~260 chars) breaks fs calls with no long component

tests: existsSync-based checks (liveLoopPid, jobRm, jobStatus) don't silently misread state when the job dir path exceeds MAX_PATH on win32
acceptance: job.ts's fs-call path construction uses namespacedJoin consistently at the cited sites; win32 long-path regression test passes
notes: Sweep of src/job.ts. existsSync swallows the too-long-path error today, so liveLoopPid reads a live loop as dead, jobStatus reports awake:[] for an awake job, jobRm reports 'no job' for one that exists; jobNew's mkdir/cp (:188,190) fail loud but avoidably, ahead of its own pinLongPaths call at :203 which only fixes git's separate limit.
